scope: offline P8U Meta target/query screen under the successor source binding; no live, admission, execution, or exchange authority

model.family: LightGBM Rank-XENDCG frozen common target/query screen

under.definition: strict-prequential unexpected favorable policy residual with trailing activation

over.definition: strict-prequential unexpected adverse stop-loss or fast-adverse residual

magnitude.definition: strict-prequential rich-policy-net residual ordinalized into train-only seven quantile grades

selection.screening: GateProxy screen only: nominate Top-3 expected gate-improving candidates, one uncertainty candidate, and one descriptor-diverse control for full strict MC1 confirmation.
selection.promotion_authority: Fresh target-free strict-OOF scoring followed by dual-MC1 admission and one constrained chronological portfolio; never GateProxy alone.
selection.feature_selection: The frozen F72 is always present. The successor 212-field SHAP/state pool is only append-eligible in downstream feature-selection stages.

causality.feature_inputs: frozen F72 target-free fields only at target/query stage; add-on features are unavailable to this stage and enter only later selection
causality.labels: policy and supportive-path labels are joined after target-free score persistence and must resolve before each fold reserve
causality.train_residual_anchor: strict prequential block anchor uses only earlier fully resolved policy outcomes
